annotations.title: Audit Meta Ads Advertisers for Leaks, Stack & Emails

description: Deduplicate Meta Ad Library datasets or DTC ad landing URLs into audited advertiser brands with tech-stack detection, DNS deliverability checks, verified emails, and outreach copy. Supply at least one source (landingPageUrls, rawCsvOrUrls, sourceDatasetId, or sourceRunId; omitting all returns 0 items at $0); dedupStoreName persists 16-shard KV snapshots for skip_seen ($0 repeats) or weekly watch_diff triggers, while onlyWithEmail, onlyWithActiveLeaks, and minLeakScore filter before billing. Persists KV dedup snapshots and optional webhookUrl batches (explaining readOnlyHint=false), runs ~15-60s per 20 brands with per-brand WAF/403/timeout isolation in OUTPUT_SUMMARY, and bills $4.50/1K unique brands ($0 on marketplaces, WAF skips, repeats, or filtered misses). Use for Meta Ad Library and DTC advertiser audits; do not use for local SMB audits (use audit_local_b2b_websites) or Shopify SKU price tracking (use monitor_shopify_competitor_deltas).

agencyPreset.description: Agency service vertical used to score leaks and tailor coldEmailSubject, coldEmailOpener, and linkedInDm.

crmExportPreset.description: Optional CRM flat column mapping preset (default keeps standard structured schema).

customAgencyOffer.description: Optional 1-line agency value proposition deterministically woven into outreach copy ($0 AI).

dedupMode.description: When dedupStoreName is set: skip_seen skips previously audited brands at $0; watch_diff detects ad/ESP/pixel/404/DMARC changes.

dedupStoreName.description: Optional Apify Named Key-Value Store (16-shard compact snapshots) for weekly skip_seen ($0 repeats) or watch_diff buying-trigger tracking.

dnsFallbackOnBlocked.description: Default false skips WAF-blocked (403/429) brands at $0. Set true to run out-of-band DNS-only audit on live blocked domains.

enableDnsEmailCheck.description: Run out-of-band 11-query DNS MX/SPF/DMARC/BIMI checks ($0) to output deliverabilityGrade (A-F) and emailProvider.

landingPageUrls.description: Up to 2,000 ad landing URLs, bare DTC domains, l.facebook.com links, or shorteners/bio links (bit.ly, linktr.ee). Optional when sourceDatasetId, sourceRunId, or rawCsvOrUrls is provided.

maxBrands.description: Maximum unique deduplicated brand domains to audit (1-2,000).

minLeakScore.description: Optional minimum 0-100 leakScore threshold ($0 below threshold).

onlyWithActiveLeaks.description: When true, skip leak-free advertisers at $0.

onlyWithEmail.description: When true, save and bill only advertisers where at least 1 brand email is recovered ($0 otherwise).

rawCsvOrUrls.description: Optional pasted CSV, TSV/Google Sheets rows, or newline-separated URLs/domains.

sourceDatasetId.description: Optional upstream Apify Dataset ID or URL from any Meta/Social Ad Library scraper (streams in 250-item pages and aggregates active ads per brand).

sourceRunId.description: Optional upstream Apify Run ID or Console URL; automatically resolves defaultDatasetId and streams records.

webhookUrl.description: Optional SSRF-protected HTTP/HTTPS webhook URL to receive audited advertiser JSON on completion.

name: audit_meta_ads_advertisers

actor.description: Apify Actor slug that produced these records.

count.description: Total number of records returned in items.

items.description: Audited DTC advertiser leads with 4-layer tech stack, live 404/OOS/DMARC leaks, buyer fit, inbox safety, and outreach copy.

buyerFitTier.description: Evidence-based maturity tier: Enterprise, Scaling DTC, Growing SMB, Early Stage, or Unknown.

detectedLeaksSummary.description: Plain-English summary of verified ad-spend or deliverability leaks.

expansionScore.description: 0-100 Tier-2 growth expansion score for healthy brands.

inboxType.description: Inbox risk classification: b2b_direct, general, cs_ticket_queue, or none.

leadPriority.description: Deterministic priority tier: VIP_HOT, WARM, or NURTURE.

outreachStatus.description: Copy safety gate: ready or manual_review_required (pair with primaryEmail, inboxType, and zeroBounceUnsafe before sending).

primaryEmail.description: Highest-priority verified brand email (null when none or quarantined).

siteStatus.description: Landing page status (ok, slow, landing_404, landing_5xx, parked_or_locked, headless_spa, headless_ssr_hydrated, bot_protected, bot_protected_dns_audited, or unreachable).
